data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that integrates Braze push, in‑app messaging and analytics.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart wrapper around the native Braze SDKs for Android and iOS, exposing APIs to initialize the SDK, track events, manage users, and handle push notifications.
use_when: You need Braze marketing automation in a Flutter app
You want native push and in‑app messaging support
You prefer a single plugin for both Android and iOS
avoid_when: You only need simple local notifications
You are targeting iOS <15 or Android <9
You want a pure Dart implementation without native code
strengths: Full native feature parity with Braze SDKs
Automatic handling of push and in‑app messages
data.setup_notes: Add XML strings and permissions on Android, configure AppDelegate on iOS, call BrazePlugin.initBraze in Dart
